title: Former barangay chairman shot dead by motorcycle-riding gunmen in Tanauan City
summary: A former barangay chairman in Tanauan City, Batangas was shot dead by motorcycle-riding gunmen along a provincial road in Barangay Talaga on Friday afternoon, police said.
